The main takeaway from our work is that
the SDN is not a standalone system, and must be verified in the context of the application it serves.
the SDN-enabled application is not just a network application, but rather a network application coupled with a domain-specific application that is tightly coupled with the network.
SDN-enabled applications require a different approach to SDN verification and validation than existing tools provide.
